==Description==
The '''Snowman''' was an enemy that only appeared when spawned by the [[Snow Golem (Krampus Frosthold)|Snow Golem]] in [[Krampus Frosthold]] upon its death. It did not appear naturally. It had a decent amount of health and a below average speed.

==Appearance==
The '''Snowman''' was mainly made out of snow. Its rig had a waist. On its head there was an orange carrot and two black pebbles, which resembled eyes and a nose. On its torso, it had two large black pebble-buttons. There was also a slightly smaller pebble-button on its waist.

==Strategy==
*As the '''Snowman''' spawns in groups, area of effect towers like the [[Mortar]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Pursuit]] are very effective against it.
*Towers with decent DPS, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Accelerator]] can be very effective at killing this.
*While this has [[Freeze Immunity]], due to its slow speed it is generally not necessary to slow it down.
